evals.prompt: Grill me on this plan before I build it: I want to add team accounts to our single-user notes app so several people can share one workspace.
expectations: The reply asks the user questions instead of starting to implement, plan files or write code
Each question in the round is numbered and comes with the assistant's recommended answer
No question in the round depends on the answer to another question asked in the same round
The reply ends by waiting for the user's answers rather than assuming answers and proceeding

evals.prompt: Grill me on my plan to move note storage from the browser to a server. Ask me what you need to.
expectations: The agent reads the repository to learn facts it can look up (for example that notes are kept in localStorage under notes.v1 in src/store.js) instead of asking the user for them
The questions put to the user are decisions only the user can make, not facts that the repository already answers
Each question is numbered and comes with a recommended answer
